contract:
Contract ManageCashDeskCRUDService::createCashDesk(id: Integer,name: String,isopened: Boolean): Boolean {
	definition:
		currentCashDesk: CashDesk = self.CurrentCashDesk
	precondition:
		CashDesk.allInstances()->forAll(c: CashDesk|c.Id<>id)
	postcondition:
		result = true and
		currentCashDesk.oclIsNew() and
		currentCashDesk.Id = id and
		currentCashDesk.Name = name and
		currentCashDesk.IsOpened = isopened and
		CashDesk.allInstances()->includes(currentCashDesk) and
		CashDesk.allInstances()->includes(currentCashDesk)
}
